DO $$
DECLARE p uuid := '258a4f01-28ac-4efb-a641-c7649e55dc95';
BEGIN
 IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.staynas_properties WHERE id=p AND name='Mtoni River Lodge') THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'Mtoni property identity check failed';
 END IF;
 IF (SELECT count(*) FROM public.rooms WHERE property_id=p AND slug IN ('mtoni-standard-room','mtoni-deluxe-room','mtoni-family-group-room')) <> 3 THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'Expected Mtoni room types are missing; aborting';
 END IF;

 UPDATE public.room_categories
 SET specifications = CASE slug
   WHEN 'mtoni-standard' THEN '{"capacity":{"adults":3,"children":2,"maximum_occupancy":3},"pricing":{"base_rate":260,"currency":"USD","included_guests":2,"extra_guest_fee":30},"inventory_units":21}'::jsonb
   WHEN 'mtoni-deluxe' THEN '{"capacity":{"adults":3,"children":2,"maximum_occupancy":3},"pricing":{"base_rate":310,"currency":"USD","included_guests":2,"extra_guest_fee":30},"inventory_units":2}'::jsonb
   WHEN 'mtoni-family-group' THEN '{"capacity":{"adults":5,"children":4,"maximum_occupancy":5},"pricing":{"base_rate":550,"currency":"USD","included_guests":5,"extra_guest_fee":0},"inventory_units":1}'::jsonb
   ELSE specifications END,
   features = CASE slug
     WHEN 'mtoni-standard' THEN ARRAY['Standard accommodation','Base rate covers 2 guests','Additional guest fee applies']
     WHEN 'mtoni-deluxe' THEN ARRAY['Deluxe accommodation','Base rate covers 2 guests','Additional guest fee applies']
     WHEN 'mtoni-family-group' THEN ARRAY['Family and group accommodation','Flat rate for up to 5 guests']
     ELSE features END
 WHERE property_id=p AND slug IN ('mtoni-standard','mtoni-deluxe','mtoni-family-group');

 UPDATE public.rooms
 SET short_description = CASE slug
     WHEN 'mtoni-standard-room' THEN 'Standard accommodation for a comfortable stay at Mtoni River Lodge.'
     WHEN 'mtoni-deluxe-room' THEN 'Deluxe accommodation for guests seeking an elevated lodge stay.'
     WHEN 'mtoni-family-group-room' THEN 'Family and group accommodation with capacity for up to five guests.'
     ELSE short_description END,
     hero_line = CASE slug
     WHEN 'mtoni-standard-room' THEN 'Comfortable lodge accommodation'
     WHEN 'mtoni-deluxe-room' THEN 'Elevated comfort at Mtoni River Lodge'
     WHEN 'mtoni-family-group-room' THEN 'Space for families and groups'
     ELSE hero_line END
 WHERE property_id=p AND slug IN ('mtoni-standard-room','mtoni-deluxe-room','mtoni-family-group-room');

 IF (SELECT count(*) FROM public.room_states WHERE property_id=p) <> 24 THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'Expected 24 physical room units after configuration';
 END IF;
END $$;

DO $$
DECLARE
  t record;
BEGIN
  FOR t IN
    SELECT n.nspname AS schema_name, c.relname AS table_name
    FROM pg_class c
    JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
    WHERE n.nspname = 'public'
      AND c.relkind = 'r'
      AND NOT c.relrowsecurity
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM information_schema.role_table_grants g
        WHERE g.table_schema = n.nspname
          AND g.table_name = c.relname
          AND g.grantee IN ('anon', 'authenticated')
          AND g.privilege_type IN ('SELECT', 'INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE')
      )
  LOOP
    EXECUTE format('ALTER TABLE %I.%I ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY', t.schema_name, t.table_name);
  END LOOP;
END
$$;

statements:
-- StayNas Phase 2: property-scoped operational calendar feed and staff schedules.
-- Additive migration. Not applied to production by this change.

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.staynas_staff_schedules (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  property_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.staynas_properties(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  staff_user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  title text NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(title)) BETWEEN 2 AND 160),
  starts_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  ends_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'scheduled'
    CHECK (status IN ('scheduled','in_progress','completed','cancelled')),
  notes text,
  created_by uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT staynas_staff_schedules_valid_range CHECK (ends_at > starts_at)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS staynas_staff_schedules_property_start_idx
  ON public.staynas_staff_schedules(property_id, starts_at, ends_at)
  WHERE status <> 'cancelled';
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS staynas_staff_schedules_staff_start_idx
  ON public.staynas_staff_schedules(staff_user_id, starts_at)
  WHERE status <> 'cancelled';

ALTER TABLE public.staynas_staff_schedules ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
REVOKE ALL ON public.staynas_staff_schedules FROM anon;
GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON public.staynas_staff_schedules TO authenticated;
GRANT ALL ON public.staynas_staff_schedules TO service_role;

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Staff read accessible schedules" ON public.staynas_staff_schedules;
CREATE POLICY "Staff read accessible schedules"
  ON public.staynas_staff_schedules FOR SELECT TO authenticated
  USING (
    public.staynas_user_has_property_access(auth.uid(), property_id)
    AND (
      staff_user_id = auth.uid()
      OR public.has_any_role(auth.uid(), ARRAY['owner','manager','admin']::public.app_role[])
    )
  );

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Managers manage accessible schedules" ON public.staynas_staff_schedules;
CREATE POLICY "Managers manage accessible schedules"
  ON public.staynas_staff_schedules FOR ALL TO authenticated
  USING (
    public.staynas_user_has_property_access(auth.uid(), property_id)
    AND public.has_any_role(auth.uid(), ARRAY['owner','manager','admin']::public.app_role[])
  )
  WITH CHECK (
    public.staynas_user_has_property_access(auth.uid(), property_id)
    AND public.has_any_role(auth.uid(), ARRAY['owner','manager','admin']::public.app_role[])
    AND public.staynas_user_has_property_access(staff_user_id, property_id)
  );

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS staynas_staff_schedules_updated_at ON public.staynas_staff_schedules;
CREATE TRIGGER staynas_staff_schedules_updated_at
  BEFORE UPDATE ON public.staynas_staff_schedules
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.set_updated_at();

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.staynas_calendar_operational_events(
  _property_id uuid,
  _from date,
  _to date
)
RETURNS TABLE (
  id uuid,
  event_kind text,
  title text,
  starts_at timestamptz,
  ends_at timestamptz,
  all_day boolean,
  status text,
  room_id uuid,
  room_state_id uuid,
  booking_id uuid,
  assignee_id uuid,
  source_type text,
  source_id uuid,
  description text
)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
STABLE
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  _timezone text;
  _uid uuid := auth.uid();
BEGIN
  IF _uid IS NULL OR NOT public.has_any_role(_uid, ARRAY['owner','manager','admin','reception','housekeeping']::public.app_role[]) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Operations calendar access required';
  END IF;
  IF NOT public.staynas_user_has_property_access(_uid, _property_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Property access denied';
  END IF;
  IF _to <= _from OR (_to - _from) > 93 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid calendar range';
  END IF;

  SELECT p.timezone INTO _timezone
  FROM public.staynas_properties p
  WHERE p.id = _property_id AND p.status = 'active';
  IF _timezone IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Active property not found'; END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    t.id,
    CASE WHEN t.category = 'maintenance' OR t.task_type ILIKE '%maintenance%' THEN 'maintenance' ELSE 'housekeeping' END,
    t.title,
    CASE
      WHEN t.status::text = 'in_progress'
        AND COALESCE(t.due_at, t.created_at) < (_from::timestamp AT TIME ZONE _timezone)
      THEN (_from::timestamp AT TIME ZONE _timezone)
      ELSE COALESCE(t.due_at, t.created_at)
    END,
    COALESCE(t.completed_at, CASE WHEN t.status::text = 'in_progress' THEN now() ELSE COALESCE(t.due_at, t.created_at, t.created_at) + interval '30 minutes' END),
    false,
    t.status::text,
    b.room_id,
    NULL::uuid,
    t.booking_id,
    COALESCE(t.assignee_id, t.assigned_to),
    'ops_task'::text,
    t.id,
    t.description
  FROM public.ops_tasks t
  JOIN public.bookings b ON b.id = t.booking_id AND b.property_id = _property_id
  WHERE t.booking_id IS NOT NULL
    AND t.category IN ('housekeeping','maintenance')
    AND t.status::text <> 'cancelled'
    AND COALESCE(t.due_at, t.created_at) < (_to::timestamp AT TIME ZONE _timezone)
    AND (
      (
        (COALESCE(t.due_at, t.created_at) AT TIME ZONE _timezone)::date >= _from
        AND (COALESCE(t.due_at, t.created_at) AT TIME ZONE _timezone)::date < _to
      )
      OR (
        t.status::text = 'in_progress'
        AND COALESCE(t.completed_at, now()) > (_from::timestamp AT TIME ZONE _timezone)
      )
    )

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    s.id,
    'staff'::text,
    s.title,
    s.starts_at,
    s.ends_at,
    false,
    s.status,
    NULL::uuid,
    NULL::uuid,
    NULL::uuid,
    s.staff_user_id,
    'staff_schedule'::text,
    s.id,
    s.notes
  FROM public.staynas_staff_schedules s
  WHERE s.property_id = _property_id
    AND s.status <> 'cancelled'
    AND s.starts_at < (_to::timestamp AT TIME ZONE _timezone)
    AND s.ends_at > (_from::timestamp AT TIME ZONE _timezone)
    AND public.staynas_user_has_property_access(s.staff_user_id, _property_id)
    AND (
      s.staff_user_id = _uid
      OR public.has_any_role(_uid, ARRAY['owner','manager','admin']::public.app_role[])
    )

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    rs.id,
    'maintenance'::text,
    'Room unavailable: ' || replace(rs.state::text, '_', ' '),
    ((now() AT TIME ZONE _timezone)::date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE _timezone),
    (((now() AT TIME ZONE _timezone)::date + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE _timezone),
    true,
    rs.state::text,
    rs.room_id,
    rs.id,
    rs.booking_id,
    NULL::uuid,
    'room_state'::text,
    rs.id,
    rs.state_note
  FROM public.room_states rs
  WHERE rs.property_id = _property_id
    AND rs.state::text IN ('maintenance','out_of_service')
    AND (_from <= (now() AT TIME ZONE _timezone)::date)
    AND (_to > (now() AT TIME ZONE _timezone)::date)

  ORDER BY 4;
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.staynas_calendar_operational_events(uuid,date,date) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.staynas_calendar_operational_events(uuid,date,date) TO authenticated, service_role;


CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.staynas_calendar_audit_events(
  _property_id uuid,
  _from date,
  _to date,
  _limit integer DEFAULT 100
)
RETURNS TABLE (
  id uuid,
  event_type text,
  room_id uuid,
  booking_id uuid,
  hold_id uuid,
  date_from date,
  date_to date,
  actor_id uuid,
  payload jsonb,
  created_at timestamptz
)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
STABLE
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  _timezone text;
  _uid uuid := auth.uid();
BEGIN
  IF _uid IS NULL OR NOT public.has_any_role(_uid, ARRAY['owner','manager','admin','reception','housekeeping']::public.app_role[]) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Operations calendar access required';
  END IF;
  IF NOT public.staynas_user_has_property_access(_uid, _property_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Property access denied';
  END IF;
  IF _to <= _from OR (_to - _from) > 93 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid calendar range';
  END IF;
  IF _limit < 1 OR _limit > 200 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid event limit';
  END IF;

  SELECT p.timezone INTO _timezone
  FROM public.staynas_properties p
  WHERE p.id = _property_id AND p.status = 'active';
  IF _timezone IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Active property not found'; END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT e.id, e.event_type, e.room_id, e.booking_id, e.hold_id,
         e.date_from, e.date_to, e.actor_id, e.payload, e.created_at
  FROM public.calendar_events e
  WHERE (
    (e.room_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.rooms r
      WHERE r.id = e.room_id AND r.property_id = _property_id
    ))
    OR (e.booking_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.bookings b
      WHERE b.id = e.booking_id AND b.property_id = _property_id
    ))
    OR (e.hold_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.booking_holds h
      WHERE h.id = e.hold_id AND h.property_id = _property_id
    ))
  )
  AND (
    (
      (e.date_from IS NOT NULL OR e.date_to IS NOT NULL)
      AND COALESCE(e.date_to, e.date_from) >= _from
      AND COALESCE(e.date_from, e.date_to) < _to
    )
    OR (
      e.date_from IS NULL AND e.date_to IS NULL
      AND (e.created_at AT TIME ZONE _timezone)::date >= _from
      AND (e.created_at AT TIME ZONE _timezone)::date < _to
    )
  )
  ORDER BY e.created_at DESC
  LIMIT _limit;
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.staynas_calendar_audit_events(uuid,date,date,integer) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.staynas_calendar_audit_events(uuid,date,date,integer) TO authenticated, service_role;


CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.staynas_calendar_list_staff(_property_id uuid)
RETURNS TABLE (user_id uuid, email text)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
STABLE
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE _uid uuid := auth.uid();
BEGIN
  IF _uid IS NULL OR NOT public.is_any_staff(_uid) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Staff access required';
  END IF;
  IF NOT public.staynas_user_has_property_access(_uid, _property_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Property access denied';
  END IF;
  IF NOT public.has_any_role(_uid, ARRAY['owner','manager','admin']::public.app_role[]) THEN
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT DISTINCT pm.user_id, COALESCE(u.email, 'Staff member')::text
  FROM public.staynas_property_members pm
  JOIN auth.users u ON u.id = pm.user_id
  WHERE pm.property_id = _property_id
    AND pm.status = 'active'
    AND public.staynas_user_has_property_access(pm.user_id, _property_id)
  ORDER BY 2;
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.staynas_calendar_list_staff(uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.staynas_calendar_list_staff(uuid) TO authenticated, service_role;

BEGIN;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.ai_omnichannel_messages (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  property_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.staynas_properties(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  session_id uuid NOT NULL,
  guest_id uuid,
  channel text NOT NULL CHECK (channel IN ('web','whatsapp','email')),
  direction text NOT NULL CHECK (direction IN ('inbound','outbound','internal')),
  actor_type text NOT NULL CHECK (actor_type IN ('guest','staff','assistant','system','provider')),
  actor_user_id uuid REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  message_type text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'text' CHECK (message_type IN ('text','template','media','event')),
  subject text,
  body text,
  body_redacted text,
  provider text,
  provider_message_id text,
  client_message_id text,
  reply_to_message_id uuid REFERENCES public.ai_omnichannel_messages(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'recorded'
    CHECK (status IN ('recorded','queued','accepted','delivered','read','failed','undeliverable')),
  metadata jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  occurred_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CHECK (body IS NOT NULL OR message_type IN ('media','event')),
  CHECK (direction <> 'outbound' OR actor_type IN ('staff','assistant','system')),
  CHECK (direction <> 'inbound' OR actor_type IN ('guest','provider'))
);

DO $sn_iq$
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint
    WHERE conname = 'ai_concierge_sessions_id_property_key'
      AND conrelid = 'public.ai_concierge_sessions'::regclass
  ) THEN
    ALTER TABLE public.ai_concierge_sessions
      ADD CONSTRAINT ai_concierge_sessions_id_property_key UNIQUE (id, property_id);
  END IF;
END
$sn_iq$;

ALTER TABLE public.ai_omnichannel_messages
  ADD CONSTRAINT ai_omnichannel_messages_session_property_fkey
  FOREIGN KEY (session_id, property_id)
  REFERENCES public.ai_concierge_sessions(id, property_id)
  ON DELETE RESTRICT;

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ai_omnichannel_messages_provider_dedupe_idx
  ON public.ai_omnichannel_messages(channel, provider, provider_message_id)
  WHERE provider_message_id IS NOT NULL;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ai_omnichannel_messages_client_dedupe_idx
  ON public.ai_omnichannel_messages(property_id, client_message_id)
  WHERE client_message_id IS NOT NULL;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ai_omnichannel_messages_property_session_time_idx
  ON public.ai_omnichannel_messages(property_id, session_id, occurred_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ai_omnichannel_messages_property_guest_time_idx
  ON public.ai_omnichannel_messages(property_id, guest_id, occurred_at DESC)
  WHERE guest_id IS NOT NULL;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.ai_guest_identity_links (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  property_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.staynas_properties(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  guest_id uuid NOT NULL,
  channel text NOT NULL CHECK (channel IN ('web','whatsapp','email')),
  identifier_type text NOT NULL CHECK (identifier_type IN ('email','phone','provider_contact_id','booking_reference','session_token')),
  identifier_hash text NOT NULL,
  identifier_ciphertext text,
  verification_method text NOT NULL CHECK (verification_method IN ('otp','magic_link','booking_verification','provider_verified','staff_verified')),
  verified_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  verified_by uuid REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  source_message_id uuid REFERENCES public.ai_omnichannel_messages(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active','revoked','superseded')),
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (property_id, channel, identifier_type, identifier_hash)
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ai_guest_identity_links_property_guest_idx
  ON public.ai_guest_identity_links(property_id, guest_id, status);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ai_guest_identity_links_lookup_idx
  ON public.ai_guest_identity_links(channel, identifier_type, identifier_hash)
  WHERE status = 'active';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.ai_guest_channel_preferences (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  property_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.staynas_properties(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  guest_id uuid NOT NULL,
  channel text NOT NULL CHECK (channel IN ('web','whatsapp','email')),
  purpose text NOT NULL CHECK (purpose IN ('transactional','service','marketing')),
  consent_status text NOT NULL CHECK (consent_status IN ('granted','denied','withdrawn','unknown')),
  consent_source text NOT NULL CHECK (consent_source IN ('guest_action','inbound_message','booking_flow','staff_recorded','imported')),
  consent_text_version text,
  evidence_message_id uuid REFERENCES public.ai_omnichannel_messages(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  captured_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  withdrawn_at timestamptz,
  updated_by uuid REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (property_id, guest_id, channel, purpose),
  CHECK ((consent_status <> 'withdrawn') OR withdrawn_at IS NOT NULL)
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ai_guest_channel_preferences_dispatch_idx
  ON public.ai_guest_channel_preferences(property_id, guest_id, channel, purpose, consent_status);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.ai_communication_dispatch_attempts (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  property_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.staynas_properties(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  session_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.ai_concierge_sessions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,

-- Nolmark CDMA founder owner and restore the idempotent channel registry seed.
-- No provider secrets are stored in this registry.

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_staynas_founder_ai_admin()
RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE sql
STABLE
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_temp
AS $$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.staynas_property_members AS member
    JOIN public.staynas_properties AS property
      ON property.id = member.property_id
    JOIN public.staynas_organisations AS organisation
      ON organisation.id = property.organisation_id
    WHERE member.user_id = auth.uid()
      AND member.role = 'owner'::public.app_role
      AND member.status = 'active'
      AND property.status = 'active'
      AND organisation.slug = 'nolmark-cdma'
      AND organisation.status = 'active'
  );
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.is_staynas_founder_ai_admin() FROM PUBLIC, anon;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.is_staynas_founder_ai_admin() TO authenticated;

statements:
-- SPE-02 corrective migration: qualify PL/pgSQL output-column names in priced availability.
BEGIN;
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_staynas_room_availability_priced(
  _check_in date,
  _check_out date,
  _property_id uuid,
  _adults integer DEFAULT 1,
  _children_below_6 integer DEFAULT 0,
  _children_7_plus integer DEFAULT 0
)
RETURNS TABLE(
  room_id uuid, slug text, name text, base_price numeric, currency text,
  capacity_adults integer, capacity_children integer, max_occupancy integer,
  included_guests integer, extra_guest_fee numeric, nights integer,
  nightly_total numeric, min_available integer, is_available boolean,
  fits_occupancy boolean, pricing_quote jsonb
)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
BEGIN
  IF _check_out <= _check_in THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'check_out must be after check_in'; END IF;
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.staynas_properties p WHERE p.id=_property_id AND p.status='active') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Property is not active or does not exist';
  END IF;
  RETURN QUERY
  WITH date_range AS (
    SELECT generate_series(_check_in,_check_out - interval '1 day',interval '1 day')::date AS d
  ), inventory AS (
    SELECT r.id AS room_id, dr.d,
      COALESCE(i.available_units,r.total_units) AS units,
      COALESCE(i.is_blocked,false) AS blocked,
      (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM public.booking_holds h
       WHERE h.room_id=r.id AND h.status='active' AND h.expires_at>now()
         AND h.check_in<=dr.d AND h.check_out>dr.d) AS hold_count
    FROM public.rooms r CROSS JOIN date_range dr
    LEFT JOIN public.room_inventory i ON i.room_id=r.id AND i.date=dr.d
    WHERE r.property_id=_property_id AND r.status='active'
  ), stock AS (
    SELECT inventory.room_id, min(greatest(units-hold_count,0))::integer AS min_units,
      bool_and(NOT blocked AND units-hold_count>0) AS available
    FROM inventory GROUP BY inventory.room_id
  )
  SELECT r.id,r.slug,r.name,r.base_price,r.currency,r.capacity_adults,r.capacity_children,
    r.max_occupancy,r.included_guests,r.extra_guest_fee,(_check_out-_check_in),
    CASE WHEN q.quote IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE (q.quote->>'total')::numeric END,
    COALESCE(s.min_units,0),(COALESCE(s.available,false) AND q.quote IS NOT NULL),
    (_adults<=r.capacity_adults
      AND (_children_below_6+_children_7_plus)<=r.capacity_children
      AND (_adults+_children_below_6+_children_7_plus)<=r.max_occupancy),
    q.quote
  FROM public.rooms r
  LEFT JOIN stock s ON s.room_id=r.id
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT public.try_calculate_staynas_booking_quote(
      _property_id,r.id,_check_in,_check_out,_adults,_children_below_6,_children_7_plus
    ) AS quote
    WHERE _adults<=r.capacity_adults
      AND (_children_below_6+_children_7_plus)<=r.capacity_children
      AND (_adults+_children_below_6+_children_7_plus)<=r.max_occupancy
  ) q ON true
  WHERE r.property_id=_property_id AND r.status='active'
  ORDER BY CASE WHEN q.quote IS NULL THEN r.base_price ELSE (q.quote->>'total')::numeric END;
END;
$$;


COMMIT;

statements:
-- SPE-04.07.01 — guest-safe eligible rate-plan discovery
BEGIN;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.discover_staynas_public_rate_plans(
  _property_id uuid,
  _room_id uuid,
  _check_in date,
  _check_out date,
  _adults integer,
  _children_below_6 integer DEFAULT 0,
  _children_7_plus integer DEFAULT 0
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_room public.rooms%ROWTYPE;
  v_plan record;
  v_quote jsonb;
  v_results jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF _property_id IS NULL OR _room_id IS NULL
     OR _check_in IS NULL OR _check_out IS NULL
     OR _check_out <= _check_in
     OR COALESCE(_adults,0) < 1
     OR COALESCE(_children_below_6,0) < 0
     OR COALESCE(_children_7_plus,0) < 0 THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok',false,'error_code','INVALID_DISCOVERY_REQUEST',
      'message','A valid property, room, stay and occupancy are required','plans','[]'::jsonb);
  END IF;

  SELECT r.* INTO v_room
  FROM public.rooms r
  WHERE r.id=_room_id AND r.property_id=_property_id AND r.status='active';
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok',false,'error_code','ROOM_NOT_FOUND',
      'message','Room is not available for this property','plans','[]'::jsonb);
  END IF;

  FOR v_plan IN
    SELECT p.id,p.name,p.description,p.meal_plan,p.refundable,p.currency
    FROM public.staynas_rate_plans p
    JOIN public.staynas_rate_plan_room_types a
      ON a.rate_plan_id=p.id
     AND a.property_id=p.property_id
     AND a.room_type_id=v_room.catalogue_type_id
     AND a.active=true
    JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT pub.id,pub.publication_number,pub.effective_from,pub.effective_to
      FROM public.staynas_rate_plan_publications pub
      WHERE pub.property_id=p.property_id AND pub.rate_plan_id=p.id
      ORDER BY pub.publication_number DESC
      LIMIT 1
    ) latest ON true
    WHERE p.property_id=_property_id
      AND p.active=true
      AND p.archived_at IS NULL
      AND p.publication_status='published'
      AND (p.effective_from IS NULL OR p.effective_from<=_check_in)
      AND (p.effective_to IS NULL OR p.effective_to>=_check_out)
      AND (latest.effective_from IS NULL OR latest.effective_from<=_check_in)
      AND (latest.effective_to IS NULL OR latest.effective_to>=_check_out)
    ORDER BY p.name,p.id
  LOOP
    v_quote := public.resolve_staynas_published_room_pricing(
      _property_id,_room_id,_check_in,_check_out,_adults,
      COALESCE(_children_below_6,0),COALESCE(_children_7_plus,0),
      v_plan.id,now()
    );
    IF v_quote->>'ok'='true' THEN
      v_results := v_results || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
        'rate_plan_id',v_plan.id,
        'name',v_plan.name,
        'description',v_plan.description,
        'meal_plan',v_plan.meal_plan,
        'refundable',v_plan.refundable,
        'currency',upper(v_plan.currency),
        'total',v_quote->'accommodation_subtotal',
        'minimum_stay',v_quote->'minimum_stay',
        'publication_id',v_quote->'publication_id',
        'publication_number',v_quote->'publication_number',
        'rate_plan_version',v_quote->'rate_plan_version',
        'snapshot_hash',v_quote->'snapshot_hash'
      ));
    END IF;
  END LOOP;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'property_id',_property_id,
    'room_id',_room_id,'check_in',_check_in,'check_out',_check_out,
    'currency',COALESCE((v_results->0->>'currency'),upper(v_room.currency)),
    'plans',v_results);
EXCEPTION
  WHEN insufficient_privilege THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok',false,'error_code','AUTHORIZATION_DENIED',
      'message','Rate-plan discovery is not authorized','plans','[]'::jsonb);
  WHEN OTHERS THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok',false,'error_code','RATE_PLAN_DISCOVERY_FAILED',
      'message','Eligible rate plans could not be resolved','plans','[]'::jsonb);
END;
$function$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.discover_staynas_public_rate_plans(uuid,uuid,date,date,integer,integer,integer) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.discover_staynas_public_rate_plans(uuid,uuid,date,date,integer,integer,integer) TO service_role;

COMMIT;

-- SPE-04.09 — expose guest-safe, auditable nightly pricing explanations.
BEGIN;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.discover_staynas_public_rate_plans(
  _property_id uuid,
  _room_id uuid,
  _check_in date,
  _check_out date,
  _adults integer,
  _children_below_6 integer DEFAULT 0,
  _children_7_plus integer DEFAULT 0
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_room public.rooms%ROWTYPE;
  v_plan record;
  v_quote jsonb;
  v_results jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  v_nightly_explanation jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF _property_id IS NULL OR _room_id IS NULL
     OR _check_in IS NULL OR _check_out IS NULL
     OR _check_out <= _check_in
     OR COALESCE(_adults,0) < 1
     OR COALESCE(_children_below_6,0) < 0
     OR COALESCE(_children_7_plus,0) < 0 THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok',false,'error_code','INVALID_DISCOVERY_REQUEST',
      'message','A valid property, room, stay and occupancy are required','plans','[]'::jsonb);
  END IF;

  SELECT r.* INTO v_room
  FROM public.rooms r
  WHERE r.id=_room_id AND r.property_id=_property_id AND r.status='active';
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok',false,'error_code','ROOM_NOT_FOUND',
      'message','Room is not available for this property','plans','[]'::jsonb);
  END IF;

  FOR v_plan IN
    SELECT p.id,p.name,p.description,p.meal_plan,p.refundable,p.currency
    FROM public.staynas_rate_plans p
    JOIN public.staynas_rate_plan_room_types a
      ON a.rate_plan_id=p.id AND a.property_id=p.property_id
     AND a.room_type_id=v_room.catalogue_type_id AND a.active=true
    JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT pub.id,pub.publication_number,pub.effective_from,pub.effective_to
      FROM public.staynas_rate_plan_publications pub
      WHERE pub.property_id=p.property_id AND pub.rate_plan_id=p.id
      ORDER BY pub.publication_number DESC LIMIT 1
    ) latest ON true
    WHERE p.property_id=_property_id AND p.active=true
      AND p.archived_at IS NULL AND p.publication_status='published'
      AND (p.effective_from IS NULL OR p.effective_from<=_check_in)
      AND (p.effective_to IS NULL OR p.effective_to>=(_check_out-1))
      AND (latest.effective_from IS NULL OR latest.effective_from<=_check_in)
      AND (latest.effective_to IS NULL OR latest.effective_to>=(_check_out-1))
    ORDER BY p.name,p.id
  LOOP
    v_quote := public.resolve_staynas_published_room_pricing(
      _property_id,_room_id,_check_in,_check_out,_adults,
      COALESCE(_children_below_6,0),COALESCE(_children_7_plus,0),
      v_plan.id,now()
    );
    IF v_quote->>'ok'='true' THEN
      -- Deliberately whitelist guest-safe fields. Internal override IDs,
      -- room-type identifiers, publication hashes and resolver internals
      -- are not exposed by this public discovery contract.
      SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'date',n.value->'date',
        'nightly_rate',n.value->'nightly_rate',
        'currency',n.value->'currency',
        'source_label',CASE n.value->>'source'
          WHEN 'approved_room_date_override' THEN 'Approved room-specific rate'
          WHEN 'approved_plan_room_type_override' THEN 'Approved plan and room-type rate'
          WHEN 'approved_room_type_override' THEN 'Approved room-type rate'
          WHEN 'approved_plan_override' THEN 'Approved rate-plan adjustment'
          WHEN 'published_daily_rate' THEN 'Published daily rate'
          WHEN 'published_seasonal_rate' THEN 'Published seasonal rate'
          WHEN 'published_occupancy_rate' THEN 'Published occupancy rate'
          WHEN 'published_base_rate' THEN 'Published base rate'
          ELSE 'Published rate'
        END,
        'pricing_basis',n.value->'pricing_basis',
        'source_rate',n.value->'source_rate'
      ) ORDER BY n.ordinality),'[]'::jsonb)
      INTO v_nightly_explanation
      FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_quote->'nightly') WITH ORDINALITY n(value,ordinality);

      v_results := v_results || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
        'rate_plan_id',v_plan.id,
        'name',v_plan.name,
        'description',v_plan.description,
        'meal_plan',v_plan.meal_plan,
        'refundable',v_plan.refundable,
        'currency',upper(v_plan.currency),
        'total',v_quote->'accommodation_subtotal',
        'average_nightly_rate',round((v_quote->>'accommodation_subtotal')::numeric/(v_quote->>'nights')::numeric,2),
        'minimum_stay',v_quote->'minimum_stay',
        'nightly_breakdown',v_nightly_explanation,
        'publication_id',v_quote->'publication_id',
        'publication_number',v_quote->'publication_number',
        'rate_plan_version',v_quote->'rate_plan_version'
      ));
    END IF;
  END LOOP;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'property_id',_property_id,
    'room_id',_room_id,'check_in',_check_in,'check_out',_check_out,
    'currency',COALESCE((v_results->0->>'currency'),upper(v_room.currency)),
    'plans',v_results);
EXCEPTION
  WHEN insufficient_privilege THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok',false,'error_code','AUTHORIZATION_DENIED',
      'message','Rate-plan discovery is not authorized','plans','[]'::jsonb);
  WHEN OTHERS THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok',false,'error_code','RATE_PLAN_DISCOVERY_FAILED',
      'message','Eligible rate plans could not be resolved','plans','[]'::jsonb);
END;
$function$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.discover_staynas_public_rate_plans(uuid,uuid,date,date,integer,integer,integer)
  FROM PUBLIC,anon,authenticated;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.discover_staynas_public_rate_plans(uuid,uuid,date,date,integer,integer,integer)
  TO service_role;

COMMIT;
